edits.reason: 'Күніне тамаққа' ('per day, to food [dative]') is grammatically awkward as a label — dative on the bare noun without a verb. 'Күндік тамақ' ('daily food') is the natural noun-phrase equivalent of FI 'Ruoka per päivä' / EN 'Food per day'.

considered_but_not_edited.note: Matches style guide place name Көк-Төбе and 'аспалы жол' is the standard Kazakh term for 'cable car / ropeway'. Good.
'көлікке бөлінген' ('split per vehicle') is slightly compressed but understandable; matches FI 'jaettu autoon'. Left.
Uses 'пакет' loanword per style guide. Good.
'екі жақты рейс' ('two-sided flight') is a mild calque but widely used in Kazakh travel sites for 'return flight'. Left.
